title: 2042-Craft
description: A very balanced Vanilla+ modpack with loads of new content, while keeping it as close to vanilla as possible
body:
A very balanced Vanilla+ modpack with loads of new content

I tried to make a modpack with loads of content while trying to not add anything too much out of the ordinary 

+++

This modpack is for people who wan't to get a fresh experience with modded minecraft without it being overwhelming. The modpack contains a very large variety of mods such as mechanics, worldgen and hard enemies. Anyone can play it multiplayer supported

Recomended to play on Hard mode for the full ''Hard'' experince. I too recomended you to play with friends for a more fun experince (Essentials mod is highly recomended for this and supported )

+++

_Keep in mind that mods can be removed/added at anytime so watch out for updates_
